articles.title: Three U.S. Naval Research Laboratory Experts Receive Sigma Xi Chapter Awards
articles.summary: Three U.S. Naval Research Laboratory (NRL) experts received the 2025 NRL Edison Chapter of Sigma Xi awards during a ceremony April 9.

articles.title: Washington National Guard, Tribal Partners Strengthen Counter-UAS Readiness
articles.summary: Washington State Counterdrug and the 10th Civil Support Team conducted Tribal Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems Fundamentals and Mission Scenarios Training at Yakima Training Center, Wash., Oct. 20–21, 2026.

articles.title: Report to Congress on U.S. Military Operations Against Iran’s Missile, Nuclear Programs
articles.summary: The following is the Oct. 20, 2026, Congressional Research Service report, U.S. Military Operations Against Iran’s Missile and Nuclear Programs. From the Report On February 28, 2026, the United States and Israel launched military operations against Iran.

articles.title: Startup Biosphere wins Pentagon contract to scale up production of key chemicals
articles.summary: The biomanufacturing facility will boast 20,000 liters of UV-sterilized vats, able to brew anything from “bio-cement” for helipads to explosives for Hellfire missiles.
